display_long_description:
Sugar Madness is a fast-paced, immersive first-person shooter, where quick thinking, strategy, skill and adaptability are the only way to survive. Grab your gear, brace yourself for the sugar rush, and get ready to take down the Candymorph hordes in the candy-themed world.

[media]

In Sugar Madness, you’re battling through a world gone completely off the rails. One minute, you’re admiring the candy-coated landscapes of the once-thriving Candy Kingdom. The next you’re ducking for cover as a swarm of mutant jawbreakers come hurtling at your face.

At the heart of this chaos is Dr. Sour—a genius, a madman, and the reason everything’s gone to hell in a candy basket. His failed experiments have twisted once-sweet confections into ravenous candymorphs, and it’s up to you and your friends in co-op mode to clean up his mess!

To beat mutated creatures and cool & funky bosses, you’ll need to choose your weapons strategically. Your varied arsenal includes weapons like the Sugar Blaster, Bubble Trap, Sweet Smasher, allowing you to switch between close and long-range combat to handle each encounter more effectively.

Main Features:
- 🔫 Vast arsenal of mind-blowing weapons
- 👾 Varied enemies
- 🤖 Mighty bosses

[media]

- 🙋 Co-op mode - team up with your friend to defeat all enemies and bosses

[media]

- 😁 Fun mini-games

[media]

With a mix of single-player and cooperative mayhem, unpredictable levels, and a Kingdom that refuses to go down without a fight, Sugar Madness is an all-out, over-the-top VR shooter.
